outline:
主要介紹陶瓷之製程及所應用的範圍.
Introduction to The processes of ceramics materials and their application

This course aims to teach students to develop a fundamental understanding of ceramic processing. The organization of course will follow the typical ceramic processing in laboratory or industry. Starting from the powder synthesis and characterization, followed by powder processing, then various forming and sintering techniques will be discussed.
schedule:
1. Powder synthesis and characterization (4 weeks)
2. Powder processing (5 weeks)
3. Ceramic forming processes (3 weeks)
4. Sintering (4 weeks)
